semantics.mechanism: Intrabar buying/selling pressure via close-location-value CLV=((C-L)-(H-C))/(H-L). Persistent pressure -> continuation; extreme -> exhaustion. NEW ingredient: intrabar close position.
semantics.signal_reason: N-bar mean CLV crosses > 0.5 (buy) or < -0.5 (sell); continue = with the pressure, exhaust = against it; onset only; enter next open.

entry.description: Fresh onset of a 3-bar mean close-location-value (CLV) crossing +-0.5.

risk_model.stop_floor: executable risk = max(2*spread_ticks*tick, 5*tick, 0.10*ATR) = max(0.20, 0.50, 0.10*ATR) price units (v2, pre-registered)
risk_model.costs: (spread 1 + slippage 1) ticks/side * 0.1 = 0.10/side; 0.20 round-trip charged in R
